description: USE THIS to get the OFFICIAL description of an ICD-10-CM diagnosis code instead of recalling it — models confidently misstate the specifics (laterality, severity, encounter type) and invent descriptions for codes that don't exist. Returns the official description, the canonical dotted form, and its 3-character category; if the code is well-formed but not in the dataset it says so rather than guessing. Accepts codes with or without the dot (E11.9 or E119).

code.description: The ICD-10-CM code, e.g. E11.9 or E119.

name: lookup_icd10
